title: Aircraft Maintenance Work Order
key_sentences: Task card TC-0412-06 was deferred under the minimum equipment list, category C, because a replacement battery pack was not in stock.
All other task cards were completed and inspected, and no further defects were found during the zonal inspection.
The following messages were downloaded from the central maintenance computer before and after the rectification work.
The work recorded above has been carried out in accordance with the approved maintenance data, and the aircraft is considered ready for release to service.

rows: Engine 1 and 2 oil filter change and chip detector inspection
Pitot probe 2 heater fault: troubleshoot and replace probe
Pack 1 outlet temperature high: clean heat exchanger
Main landing gear tyre pressure check and servicing
Cabin emergency lighting battery capacity test

list_items.text: (i) PROBE HEAT 2 caution displayed during climb on sector PEY–KRW.
(ii) Pack 1 outlet temperature reached the upper limit during taxi at high ambient temperature.
(iii) Cabin crew reported that one emergency light near door 2L appeared dim during the preflight check.
all tools and equipment were accounted for;
the deferred defect was entered in the technical log with its expiry date;
engine ground runs showed no leaks at the oil filter housings;
the pitot-static leak check on system 2 was within limits.
